deliverables: 12 months of production maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet support
Maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
Support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect
Vendor-required product or security audits where firmware or app changes trigger them
Transparent capped T&M reporting with milestones and evidence
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor
request.what: Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, including Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli, developer support for ecosystem integrators, externally maintained component integration support where shared flows intersect, and vendor-required product or security audits.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The requested withdrawal is for 12 months of production maintenance rather than building a new wallet product.

The proposed work covers Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, supporting libraries and cardano-hw-cli maintenance, integrator support, related externally maintained component flows, and vendor-required audits.
The proposer states that continuous hardware-wallet maintenance is needed to avoid users and integrators losing secure access when Cardano, Ledger, or Trezor introduce breaking changes.
The proposer states that funding continuity in 2026 is less costly and less disruptive than waiting for compatibility breakage to accumulate.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit at submission, either alone or in aggregate.
Intersect plans to administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based signoff rules, and external oversight entities.
The proposal names Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl as external Oversight Committee members for checks on key administrative actions.

The proposal discloses prior related treasury or Catalyst funding links for hardware wallets maintenance, Ledger app rewrite, IO and VacuumLabs Plutus work, Ledger Live integration, message signing, security, and token-related projects.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ada for a 2026 continuity maintenance package for Cardano hardware-wallet compatibility and supporting tooling, administered by Intersect through treasury smart contracts with stated oversight and prior-funding disclosures.
